description: Call any read-only (view/pure) function on a Base contract and get the decoded answer. Give the function as a signature like balanceOf(address) returns (uint256) plus args, or raw 0x calldata. Supports address, bool, uint/int, bytesN, string, bytes and arrays, an optional historical block, and plain revert reasons. Raw return data is always included. Not charged for invalid input, reverted calls, or when Base can't be reached. Paid via x402; see list_prices.

args.description: Arguments in order (big numbers as strings; arrays as lists).

data.description: Optional instead of function: raw 0x calldata.

returns.description: Optional: return types if not in the signature, e.g. "uint112,uint112,uint32".

name: contract_call
title: Read any contract function on Base and get the decoded result
